## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and any security or privacy implications.

## Validation

List commands and results, including checks that could not run.

- [ ] Tests cover meaningful behavior changes.
- [ ] No prompts, source code, credentials, or personal logs in fixtures or diagnostics.
- [ ] Ownership and cancellation are explicit for new long-lived resources.
- [ ] Version, changelog, and documentation updated when relevant.
- [ ] Commits are signed; title follows `type(scope): imperative`.
